```{r pkg}
library(ecoTemporalNet)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
```


```{r overlap}
# Compatibility wrappers so the vignette still works if function names changed
shortest_paths_fn <- function(g) {
  ns <- asNamespace("ecoTemporalNet")
  if (exists("calculate_overlap_shortest_paths", envir = ns, inherits = FALSE)) {
    ecoTemporalNet::calculate_overlap_shortest_paths(g)
  } else if (exists("calculate_shortest_paths", envir = ns, inherits = FALSE)) {
    ecoTemporalNet::calculate_shortest_paths(g)
  } else {
    stop("No shortest-path function found in ecoTemporalNet.")
  }
}

distance_fn <- function(g) {
  ns <- asNamespace("ecoTemporalNet")
  if (exists("calculate_overlap_hop_distance", envir = ns, inherits = FALSE)) {
    ecoTemporalNet::calculate_overlap_hop_distance(g)
  } else if (exists("calculate_distance", envir = ns, inherits = FALSE)) {
    ecoTemporalNet::calculate_distance(g)
  } else {
    stop("No distance function found in ecoTemporalNet.")
  }
}

weighted_distance_fn <- function(g) {
  ns <- asNamespace("ecoTemporalNet")
  if (exists("calculate_weighted_overlap_distance", envir = ns, inherits = FALSE)) {
    ecoTemporalNet::calculate_weighted_overlap_distance(g)
  } else if (exists("calculate_distance_weights", envir = ns, inherits = FALSE)) {
    ecoTemporalNet::calculate_distance_weights(g)
  } else {
    stop("No weighted-distance function found in ecoTemporalNet.")
  }
}
```



```{r }
frog1_path <- system.file("extdata", "frogcomtest1.csv", package = "ecoTemporalNet")
frog2_path <- system.file("extdata", "frogcomtest2.csv", package = "ecoTemporalNet")
frog3_path <- system.file("extdata", "frogcomtest3.csv", package = "ecoTemporalNet")

stopifnot(
  nzchar(frog1_path),
  nzchar(frog2_path),
  nzchar(frog3_path)
)

pond1c14 <- readr::read_csv(frog1_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
pond4c5  <- readr::read_csv(frog2_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
pond4c15 <- readr::read_csv(frog3_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

knitr::kable(head(pond1c14), caption = "Example phenology data")
```

# Plot phenology intervals

```{r }
plot_phenology <- function(dat, title = NULL) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    dat,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = start_day,
      xend = end_day + 0.5,
      y = reorder(factor(species), -start_day),
      yend = factor(species)
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(linewidth = 8) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Day of Year", y = "Species", title = title) +
    ggplot2::theme_classic()
}

plot_phenology(pond1c14, "Pond 1, Community 14")
plot_phenology(pond4c5,  "Pond 4, Community 5")
plot_phenology(pond4c15, "Pond 4, Community 15")
```

pond4c15 has relatively few species and includes a temporally isolated species.
The other two communities have more species and more complicated overlap patterns.

# Check temporal overlap

```{r }
overlap <- ecoTemporalNet::check_temporal_overlap(pond4c5)
edges <- overlap$edges
weights <- overlap$weights

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    from = edges[, 1],
    to = edges[, 2],
    overlap_days = weights
  ),
  caption = "Directed edges and overlap durations"
)
```




# build networls

```{r }
g1 <- ecoTemporalNet::create_temporal_network(pond1c14)
g2 <- ecoTemporalNet::create_temporal_network(pond4c5)
g3 <- ecoTemporalNet::create_temporal_network(pond4c15)

g1
g2
g3
```


# visualize networks

```{r }
plot(
  g1,
  vertex.label = igraph::V(g1)$name,
  edge.width = igraph::E(g1)$weight / 5,
  main = "Temporal Ecological Network: pond1c14"
)

plot(
  g2,
  vertex.label = igraph::V(g2)$name,
  edge.width = igraph::E(g2)$weight / 5,
  main = "Temporal Ecological Network: pond4c5"
)

plot(
  g3,
  vertex.label = igraph::V(g3)$name,
  edge.width = igraph::E(g3)$weight / 5,
  main = "Temporal Ecological Network: pond4c15"
)
```
